description: This file defines the CronCommand class for managing scheduled tasks within the Goteo application, including adding jobs, reading YAML configurations, and executing cron jobs via Symfony Console.

classes.name: CronCommand
classes.description: A console command class for managing and executing scheduled cron jobs within the Goteo application.

methods.name: setResolver
methods.description: Sets the static resolver instance used for managing jobs.

methods.name: getResolver
methods.description: Retrieves the resolver instance, initializing it if necessary.

methods.name: addJob
methods.description: Adds a job to the resolver.

methods.name: addSchedule
methods.description: Creates and adds a scheduled job from a shell command and schedule string.

methods.name: __construct
methods.description: Constructor that loads predefined tasks from a YAML configuration file.

methods.name: configure
methods.description: Configures the console command options and help text.

methods.name: execute
methods.description: Executes the cron command, listing or running scheduled jobs based on options.
